title: Can you really tell if a kid is lying?
speaker: Kang Lee

sentences.en: Hi. Let me ask the audience a question: Did you ever lie as a child?
sentences.zh: 大家好 我先问大家一个问题： 作为一个孩子的时候您撒过谎么？

sentences.en: If you did, could you please raise your hand?
sentences.zh: 如果有过 可以举手么？

sentences.en: Wow! This is the most honest group of people I've ever met.
sentences.zh: 天啊！这是我 遇见过的最诚实的一群人

sentences.en: (Laughter) So for the last 20 years, I've been studying how children learn to tell lies.
sentences.zh: （笑声） 在过去的二十年， 我一直在研究孩子们如何学会撒谎。

sentences.en: And today, I'm going to share with you some of the discoveries we have made.
sentences.zh: 今天我将与给分享 我们的一些成果。

sentences.en: But to begin, I'm going to tell you a story from Mr. Richard Messina, who is my friend and an elementary school principal.
sentences.zh: 不过首先我想先讲一个 理查德·梅西纳先生的故事。 他是我的朋友 也是一名小学校长。

sentences.en: He got a phone call one day. The caller says, "Mr. Messina, my son Johnny will not come to school today because he's sick."
sentences.zh: “梅西纳先生，我的孩子乔尼 今天不去学校了

sentences.en: Mr. Messina asks, "Who am I speaking to, please?"
sentences.zh: 梅西纳先生问道 ”请问您是谁？“

sentences.en: And the caller says, "I am my father." (Laughter) So this story -- (Laughter) sums up very nicely three common beliefs we have
sentences.zh: 很好的总结了三个我们

sentences.en: about children and lying. One, children only come to tell lies after entering elementary school.
sentences.zh: 对于孩子撒谎的常识。 第一，孩子通常在上小学后 开始撒谎。

sentences.en: Two, children are poor liars. We adults can easily detect their lies.
sentences.zh: 第二，孩子不会撒谎 成人可以简单地识破他们。

sentences.en: And three, if children lie at a very young age, there must be some character flaws with them, and they are going to become pathological liars for life.
sentences.zh: 第三，如果孩子很早就开始撒谎 那么他们一定有一些人格缺陷， 并且一生都将是病态的撒谎者。

sentences.en: Well, it turns out all of the three beliefs are wrong.
sentences.zh: 然而结果是， 这三个认识都是错的

sentences.en: We have been playing guessing games with children all over the world.
sentences.zh: 之前我们一直和全世界的 孩子们一起玩竞猜游戏。

sentences.en: Here is an example. So in this game, we asked children to guess the numbers on the cards.
sentences.zh: 这里有一个例子。 在这个游戏中， 我们请孩子们猜测卡片上的数字。

sentences.en: And we tell them if they win the game, they are going to get a big prize.
sentences.zh: 并告诉他们如果他们猜中了， 他们会得到丰厚的奖励。

sentences.en: But in the middle of the game, we make an excuse and leave the room.
sentences.zh: 在游戏的中间， 我们会借故离开。

sentences.en: And before we leave the room, we tell them not to peek at the cards.
sentences.zh: 离开前会告诉孩子们 不要去偷偷看卡片。

sentences.en: Of course, we have hidden cameras in the room to watch their every move.
sentences.zh: 当然了， 隐藏的摄像头在房间 观察孩子们的一举一动。

sentences.en: Because the desire to win the game is so strong, more than 90 percent of children will peek as soon as we leave the room.
sentences.zh: 因为孩子太想赢这个游戏， 超过90%的孩子在我们离开后马上

sentences.en: (Laughter) The crucial question is: When we return and ask the children whether or not they have peeked, will the children who peeked confess
sentences.zh: 当然们回来并且问孩子们 那些偷看了卡片的孩子

sentences.en: or lie about their transgression? We found that regardless of gender, country, religion, at two years of age, 30 percent lie,
sentences.zh: 我们发现无论 性别 国籍 宗教信仰

sentences.en: 70 percent tell the truth about their transgression.
sentences.zh: 70%承认了他们违反游戏规则。

sentences.en: At three years of age, 50 percent lie and 50 percent tell the truth.
sentences.zh: 三岁的孩子中， 撒谎的人占了50%。

sentences.en: At four years of age, more than 80 percent lie.
sentences.zh: 四岁的孩子 超过80%都在撒谎。

sentences.en: And after four years of age, most children lie.
sentences.zh: 大于四岁的孩子 绝大部分都在撒谎。

sentences.en: So as you can see, lying is really a typical part of development.
sentences.zh: 如您所见， 撒谎是成长典型的一部分。

sentences.en: And some children begin to tell lies as young as two years of age.
sentences.zh: 很多孩子在2岁的时候 就已经学会了撒谎。

sentences.en: So now, let's take a closer look at the younger children.
sentences.zh: 现在我们仔细研究小孩子。

sentences.en: Why do some but not all young children lie?
sentences.zh: 为什么不是所有的孩子都撒谎？

sentences.en: In cooking, you need good ingredients to cook good food.
sentences.zh: 在烹饪领域想做出好的食物 需要好的原料。

sentences.en: And good lying requires two key ingredients.
sentences.zh: 一个好的谎言需要两个关键的原料。

sentences.en: The first key ingredient is theory of mind, or the mind-reading ability.
sentences.zh: 第一个是心智理论， 换言之读心的能力。

sentences.en: Mind reading is the ability to know that different people have different knowledge about the situation and the ability to differentiate between what I know and what you know.
sentences.zh: 知道相同情况下 不同的人知道不同的事情的能力， 是一种 可以区分我知道什么

sentences.en: Mind reading is important for lying because the basis of lying is that I know you don't know what I know.
sentences.zh: 读心在撒谎时能力很重要 因为撒谎从根本上说

sentences.en: Therefore, I can lie to you. The second key ingredient for good lying is self-control.
sentences.zh: 第二个撒谎的 关键因素是自我控制

sentences.en: It is the ability to control your speech, your facial expression and your body language, so that you can tell a convincing lie.
sentences.zh: 控制语言 控制面部表情 这样的谎言才让人信服。

sentences.en: And we found that those young children who have more advanced mind-reading and self-control abilities tell lies earlier and are more sophisticated liars.
sentences.zh: 我们发现那些小孩子中 读心能力和自我控制能力更强的 也成为了更老练的撒谎者。

sentences.en: As it turns out, these two abilities are also essential for all of us to function well in our society.
sentences.zh: 事实证明 这两种能力 在社会中也是至关重要的。

sentences.en: In fact, deficits in mind-reading and self-control abilities are associated with serious developmental problems, such as ADHD and autism.
sentences.zh: 并且读心能力和自我控制能力不足 经常和一些严重的 发展问题 比如多动症和自闭症 联系在一起。

sentences.en: So if you discover your two-year-old is telling his or her first lie, instead of being alarmed, you should celebrate -- (Laughter) because it signals that your child has arrived at a new milestone
sentences.zh: 所以当你发现你二岁的孩子开始撒谎 这意味着你的孩子进入了 典型发展的

sentences.en: of typical development. Now, are children poor liars?
sentences.zh: 新的里程碑。 那么 孩子不会撒谎么？

sentences.en: Do you think you can easily detect their lies?
sentences.zh: 你可以轻易的识破他们的谎言么？

sentences.en: Would you like to give it a try? Yes? OK.
sentences.zh: 你愿意试试么？ 愿意？好的

sentences.en: So I'm going to show you two videos. In the videos, the children are going to respond to a researcher's question, "Did you peek?"
sentences.zh: 我将要给各位看两段视频。 孩子们将会回答研究者的问题

sentences.en: So try to tell me which child is lying and which child is telling the truth.
sentences.zh: 试着告诉我 哪一个孩子撒谎 那一个孩子说真话。

sentences.en: Here's child number one. Are you ready? (Video) Adult: Did you peek? Child: No.
sentences.zh: 这是第一个孩子。 （视频）-你撒谎了么？-没有。

sentences.en: Kang Lee: And this is child number two. (Video) Adult: Did you peek? Child: No.
sentences.zh: 这是第二个孩子 （视频）-你撒谎了么？-没有。

sentences.en: KL: OK, if you think child number one is lying, please raise your hand.
sentences.zh: 认为第一个孩子撒谎的， 请举手。

sentences.en: And if you think child number two is lying, please raise your hand.
sentences.zh: 认为第二个孩子撒谎的， 请举手

sentences.en: OK, so as a matter of fact, child number one is telling the truth, child number two is lying.
sentences.zh: 事实上， 第一个孩子说的是真话 第二个孩子在撒谎

sentences.en: Looks like many of you are terrible detectors of children's lies.
sentences.zh: 看起来大家完全无法识破 孩子的谎言。

sentences.en: (Laughter) Now, we have played similar kinds of games with many, many adults from all walks of life.
sentences.zh: （笑声) 现在我们给很多 从事各种行业的成年人

sentences.en: And we show them many videos. In half of the videos, the children lied.
sentences.zh: 播放类似的视频。 视频中一半的孩子撒谎了。

sentences.en: In the other half of the videos, the children told the truth.
sentences.zh: 另一半的孩子讲了真话。

sentences.en: And let's find out how these adults performed.
sentences.zh: 让我们看看成人识破谎言的表现。

sentences.en: Because there are as many liars as truth tellers, if you guess randomly, there's a 50 percent chance you're going to get it right.
sentences.zh: 因为说真话和假话的孩子各一半， 如果你随机的猜， 你的正确率差不多50%。

sentences.en: So if your accuracy is around 50 percent, it means you are a terrible detector of children's lies.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你的准确率在50%左右， 说明你看不出孩子的谎言。

sentences.en: So let's start with undergrads and law school students, who typically have limited experience with children.
sentences.zh: 我们先从和小孩子的交集 有限的本科生和法学院学生开始。

sentences.en: No, they cannot detect children's lies. Their performance is around chance.
sentences.zh: 不 他们看不出孩子撒谎了， 他们只是随机的猜测。

sentences.en: Now how about social workers and child-protection lawyers, who work with children on a daily basis?
sentences.zh: 那么每天和孩子打交道的 社会工作者和保护儿童的律师 做得如何呢？

sentences.en: Can they detect children's lies? No, they cannot.
sentences.zh: 他们可以分辨孩子的谎言么？ 不他们不能。

sentences.en: (Laughter) What about judges, customs officers and police officers, who deal with liars on a daily basis?
sentences.zh: 海关官员， 或者警察呢？ 他们每天都在面对谎言，

sentences.en: Can they detect children's lies? No, they cannot.
sentences.zh: 他们可以看出孩子撒谎么？ 不他们不能。

sentences.en: What about parents? Can parents detect other children's lies?
sentences.zh: 父母呢？ 父母可以看出别的孩子撒谎么？

sentences.en: No, they cannot. What about, can parents detect their own children's lies?
sentences.zh: 不他们不能。 那么父母可以看出 自己的孩子撒谎么？

sentences.en: No, they cannot. (Laughter) (Applause) So now you may ask why children's lies are so difficult to detect.
sentences.zh: （笑声）（掌声） 为什么孩子的谎言不容易被识破?

sentences.en: Let me illustrate this with my own son, Nathan.
sentences.zh: 让我用我的儿子内森来说明。

sentences.en: This is his facial expression when he lies.
sentences.zh: 这是他撒谎时 的面部表情。

sentences.en: (Laughter) So when children lie, their facial expression is typically neutral.
sentences.zh: （笑声） 所以孩子撒谎是 他们的面部表情是很自然的。

sentences.en: However, behind this neutral expression, the child is actually experiencing a lot of emotions, such as fear, guilt, shame and maybe a little bit of liar's delight.
sentences.zh: 然而在自然的表情背后 孩子在体验一系列的感情 有害怕，内疚，羞耻 也许还有一点骗人的喜悦。

sentences.en: (Laughter) Unfortunately, such emotions are either fleeting or hidden.
sentences.zh: （笑声） 可是这些表情或一闪而过 或被隐藏的很好

sentences.en: Therefore, it's mostly invisible to us. So in the last five years, we have been trying to figure out a way to reveal these hidden emotions.
sentences.zh: 对于我们来说很难捕捉。 我们一直在寻找 挖掘隐藏的表情的办法。

sentences.en: Then we made a discovery. We know that underneath our facial skin, there's a rich network of blood vessels.
sentences.zh: 我们知道在脸的皮肤下面 是丰富的血管网络。

sentences.en: When we experience different emotions, our facial blood flow changes subtly.
sentences.zh: 在我们经历不同的情感的时候， 我们面部血液流动也会稍微改变。

sentences.en: And these changes are regulated by the autonomic system that is beyond our conscious control.
sentences.zh: 这些改变受自动系统的控制 人为无法刻意改变。

sentences.en: By looking at facial blood flow changes, we can reveal people's hidden emotions.
sentences.zh: 通过观察面部血液流动变化， 我们可以发现人们隐藏的表情。

sentences.en: Unfortunately, such emotion-related facial blood flow changes are too subtle to detect by our naked eye.
sentences.zh: 不过这种情感相关的 血液流动 太过于微小以至于肉眼无法看到。

sentences.en: So to help us reveal people's facial emotions, we have developed a new imaging technology we call "transdermal optical imaging."
sentences.zh: 所以我们设计了新的图像技术 来帮助我们捕捉人们的面部表情。 我们叫它“透皮光学成像”。

sentences.en: To do so, we use a regular video camera to record people when they experience various hidden emotions.
sentences.zh: 我们用普通的镜头记录 正在经历着各种隐藏的感情的人

sentences.en: And then, using our image processing technology, we can extract transdermal images of facial blood flow changes.
sentences.zh: 然后使用图像处理技术 我们可以通过观察经皮视频，

sentences.en: By looking at transdermal video images, now we can easily see facial blood flow changes associated with the various hidden emotions.
sentences.zh: 提取面部血液流动的经皮图像。 由于各种隐藏的表情 造成的血液流动。

sentences.en: And using this technology, we can now reveal the hidden emotions associated with lying, and therefore detect people's lies.
sentences.zh: 我们可以判断 与撒谎相关的隐藏表情 进而识破人们的谎言。

sentences.en: We can do so noninvasively, remotely, inexpensively, with an accuracy at about 85 percent, which is far better than chance level.
sentences.zh: 我们可以在 不侵害被试者的情况下 远程地 廉价地进行操作 并且有85%的准确率，

sentences.en: And in addition, we discovered a Pinocchio effect.
sentences.zh: 此外我们发现了匹诺曹现象。

sentences.en: No, not this Pinocchio effect. (Laughter) This is the real Pinocchio effect.
sentences.zh: 不不不不是这个现象。 这是真的匹诺曹现象。

sentences.en: When people lie, the facial blood flow on the cheeks decreases, and the facial blood flow on the nose increases.
sentences.zh: 脸颊的面部血液流动减少 鼻子的血液流动增加。

sentences.en: Of course, lying is not the only situation that will evoke our hidden emotions.
sentences.zh: 当然撒谎并不是 激发隐藏表情的唯一情况。

sentences.en: So then we asked ourselves, in addition to detecting lies, how can our technology be used?
sentences.zh: 所以我们思考， 除了测试谎言之外， 这项技术还可以用来做什么？

sentences.en: One application is in education. For example, using this technology, we can help this mathematics teacher to identify the student in his classroom who may experience high anxiety about the topic he's teaching
sentences.zh: 在教育领域可以应用这门技术。 比如使用这项技术可以帮助 这位数学老师 深感焦虑的学生。

sentences.en: so that he can help him. And also we can use this in health care.
sentences.zh: 这可以很好地帮助老师。 这门技术同时可以用在健康护理上。

sentences.en: For example, every day I Skype my parents, who live thousands of miles away.
sentences.zh: 比如 每天我和离我几千公里 的父母Skype，

sentences.en: And using this technology, I can not only find out what's going on in their lives but also simultaneously monitor their heart rate, their stress level, their mood and whether or not they are experiencing pain.
sentences.zh: 我不仅可以知道他们那里发生了什么 同时我可以监测他们的心率 紧张程度 他们的情绪或者是否处于痛苦之中。

sentences.en: And perhaps in the future, their risks for heart attack or hypertension.
sentences.zh: 也许将来 心脏病和高血压的风险 也可以被检测出来

sentences.en: And you may ask: Can we use this also to reveal politicians' emotions?
sentences.zh: 我们可以识破政客的表情么？

sentences.en: (Laughter) For example, during a debate.
sentences.zh: （笑声） 比如在辩论中的表情

sentences.en: Well, the answer is yes. Using TV footage, we could detect the politicians' heart rate, mood and stress, and perhaps in the future, whether or not they are lying to us.
sentences.zh: 我们可以检测政客的心率， 也许将来也可以判断他们是否在说谎。

sentences.en: We can also use this in marketing research, for example, to find out whether or not people like certain consumer products.
sentences.zh: 这项技术也可以用于市场调查， 比如去探究 人们喜不喜欢特定的消费产品。

sentences.en: We can even use it in dating. So for example, if your date is smiling at you, this technology can help you to determine whether she actually likes you or she is just trying to be nice to you.
And in this case, she is just trying to be nice to you.
sentences.zh: 在这个照片中， 她只是想对他友善一点。

sentences.en: (Laughter) So transdermal optical imaging technology is at a very early stage of development.
sentences.zh: （笑声） 所以透皮光学成像技术 仅仅处于起步阶段。

sentences.en: Many new applications will come about that we don't know today.
sentences.zh: 将来会有更多 意想不到的新应用出现。

sentences.en: However, one thing I know for sure is that lying will never be the same again.
sentences.zh: 然而我坚信 研究谎言的未来 将会因此变得不同。

sentences.en: Thank you very much. Xiè xie. (Applause)
sentences.zh: （掌声）
